note: Summary of the offline backtest (analysis/calibrate.py, full detail in CALIBRATION.md). Surfaced on the methodology page so the validation is public.
headline: Occupations in our highest-risk band lost jobs on average over 2020-2025, while the lowest-risk band grew the most - the risk ranking separates real outcomes in the right order. Individual prediction is weak (cross-validated R2 ~ 0.05), so results are shown as ranges, not point verdicts.
caveat: The 2020 base year is the COVID shock and AI's large labor effects are recent, so this validates direction and plumbing, not a precise score.
